ppg_model.note: The joblib file is the sklearn pipeline (StandardScaler + Ridge on the 7 handcrafted features) re-saved from the torch artifact by rppg/experiments/ppg_served_model/export_joblib.py, so the server needs no torch.

forecaster.error_bands_provenance: 90th percentile of absolute held-out error (mg/dL) per horizon and g0 source, nested CV (GroupKFold(5) x 5 by participant), pooled over test meals and noise draws. The committed gbdt_results hold no residuals, so they were recomputed without permutations (MAE reproduces the committed trial exactly: T+60 CGM 28.78, meter 29.69, PPG 36.02). meter/cgm: `python -m forecasting.evaluate.gbdt_forecaster --data-root <CGMacros> --permutations 0 --out /tmp/gbdt_bands_main`; ppg: same with `--ppg-residuals rppg/models/reports/ppg_served_residuals.csv --out /tmp/gbdt_bands_ppg` (trial's simulated PPG g0; those models also saw PPG rows, the served models did not, so the PPG band is optimistic for the served models); then `python -m forecasting.evaluate.error_bands --cgm-meter /tmp/gbdt_bands_main --ppg /tmp/gbdt_bands_ppg`.
